device_op_gate_pin_v3.architecture: Three MoLinear layers (2F+8 -> model.dim -> model.dim -> model.heads); each layer has independent input-softmax routing over all experts, with Dropout then GELU between layers; one gate shared across the selected self-attention layers.
adaptations: Gate-specific input/output widths and train-supported OP handling inherited from v2.
Hidden expert/router Xavier initialization follows the inspected source; final expert weights use small independent random values and common logit(initial_gate) biases.
